# Volts & VINs (https://voltsandvins.com)

> Volts & VINs is a direct used-Tesla inventory and price benchmark index covering 15,134 listings across the United States (1,053 priced $500+ below mileage-adjusted peer asking benchmarks). Direct online reservation and delivery.

## Key Marketplace Facts
- **Published VIN-Decoded Catalog**: 15,134 used Tesla vehicles (Model Y, Model 3, Model S, Model X, Cybertruck)
- **Peer-Benchmarked Price Finds**: 1,053 listings priced `$500+` below mileage-adjusted peer asking prices (minimum 5 comparable peers in the same model, year, trim, drivetrain, and mileage band)
- **VIN-Decoded Specifications**: Listings include VIN-derived build factory and drivetrain where decoded, with recorded mileage and vehicle location. Build factory is not the current vehicle location
- **Purchase & Reservation Model**: Direct online purchase and reservation through Volts & VINs. Start with a $0 price lock, verify clean title and inspection details, then place a refundable $250 deposit to complete your order and arrange delivery.
